confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors for July peak season are less certain and could vary widely with demand. Drink prices are based on general knowledge of Mykonos pricing. FX: the 2026-10-15 RBA value (0.6955 USD per AUD) was taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page, and I did not open that page directly. A third-party site reported a 2026-10-16 value of 0.6947, which I did not use because it is not from rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of peak-season pricing on Mykonos and comparable Cycladic resort islands such as Santorini, adjusted for Mykonos running above most other Greek islands in July. Accommodation prices are typical July rates including taxes and fees.
